product.tagline: An equaliser for everything your Windows PC plays, with 85 presets, a live spectrum and audio that follows your headphones in and out.
product.summary: Portal Equalizer gives Equalizer APO, the system-wide audio engine for Windows, the interface it never had. Shape the sound of each output with a ten-band EQ, let the app suggest a preset for whatever is playing, and have audio switch devices by your own priority order. The engine installs through its own installer from inside the app, and a Restore button puts every device back if one ever goes quiet.

features.title: Ten-band EQ for each device
features.detail: Every output keeps its own curve, and the preamp is set for you so a boost never clips.

features.title: 85 presets, or one obvious pick
features.detail: Browse the whole catalogue in Advanced, or switch to Simple for one clear choice per intent.

features.title: A preset for what is playing
features.detail: A live spectrum reads what the PC is playing and suggests a matching preset or a correction curve. Nothing changes until you click.

features.title: Smarter suggestions, if you want them
features.detail: Point it at an Agent Platform server and suggestions also weigh the track title and artist. Leave the address blank and the local match works on its own.

features.title: Device switching by priority
features.detail: Unplug the headphones and sound falls back to the next device on your list, the way you would have done it by hand.

features.title: Per-app routing
features.detail: Pin one app to one output, say Spotify to the speakers, and leave the system default alone.

features.title: Now playing
features.detail: See the current track with its cover art, and play, pause or skip from the window.

features.title: A way back
features.detail: Your existing Equalizer APO config and every device's registry state are saved before the engine goes in, and Restore in Settings puts them back.
